# @metator/cli

<!-- metator:generated:start -->
<!-- Generated by `metator cards build` from the import graph. Edit the sections below, not this block. -->

- Third-party: `commander`

## Responsibility

Driving adapter on commander: one module per command group, JSON-only output, exit codes.

## Invariants

- Commander never prints; every outcome becomes one JSON envelope [[cite: packages/cli/src/program.ts:37 | ".configureOutput({ writeOut: () => {}, writeErr: () => {} })"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `@metator/runtime`. Commands resolve use cases from the container and never construct adapters (MT-ARCH-007).

## Pitfalls

- Validate option values with commander (`choices`, `argParser`), not by hand (MT-CODE-004).
- A new command must be added to the help list in `e2e/cli.e2e.test.ts`.
